The '''High City of Refuge''' was a metropolis on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kidron/Legends|Kidron]]. It was surrounded by a thirty-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] wall and topped by a reinforced [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] dome. It was ruled over by the [[High City Council|City High Council]].
